decisions: Preserve four overlapping catalog denominators/hashes and existing CLI stage/weight snapshot. Map143 product rows to all272 feature bullets and488 total mission bullets, with11 separate governance groups.
Represent inventory, partial implementation, current qualification, merge, deployment and acceptance independently. Historical source/issue observations are not silently refreshed.
Require exact source/layer/environment/criteria and full-scope evidence for any whole-requirement credit; issue closure, existing files and historical tests cannot grant it.
Validate source references, baseline IDs, issue ownership URLs, mission coverage, dependencies and saved main delivery receipts; reject stale generated output in normal build/check/package gates.
Include the capabilities input and output directory in explicit reviewed-source freshness; rendering never approves source.

Bind consumed research/main-receipt bytes to reviewed hashes; require exact six main check names and explicit evidence-source repository/layer ownership. Unknown delivery labels and unaccepted final prerequisites fail closed.

Repair the prepack fixture leaf inventory for the real capability gate, preserving normal build/check/prepack policy. Require each rejected gate to have executed before compilation/publication is blocked.
